title: How Latino Voters Are Experiencing the 2026 Midterm Elections
summary_en: Democratic congressional candidates have a sizable advantage among Latino registered voters. And Latino Democratic candidate supporters are more engaged with this year’s election compared with four years ago.
title_cn: How Latino Voters Are Experiencing the 2026 Midterm Elections

title: The Gender Gap in AI
summary_en: Men and women now use AI chatbots at similar rates, but men use them more often, while women are more skeptical of AI’s impact on their lives.

title: Republicans’ Views of Some Countries and International Organizations Differ Widely by Age
summary_en: Younger Republicans’ views of some countries and international organizations are sometimes closer to Democrats’ views than they are to those of older Republicans.
title_cn: Republicans’ Views of Some Countries and International Organizations Differ Widely by Age

title: How Do Americans Feel About G20 Countries?
summary_en: Ahead of this year’s G20 summit, most Americans rate Australia, Canada, Japan, Italy and other members warmly. Sentiment is coldest toward Russia.
title_cn: How Do Americans Feel About G20 Countries?
